mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND b.is_listed = true) AS block_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ub.user_id) FROM user_block ub JOIN block b ON b.id = ub.block_id WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND ub.user_id <> u.id) AS collector_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.play_count), 0) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = u.id AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true) AS play_count FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_active = true

SELECT COALESCE(p.code, c.code) AS code, COALESCE(p.name, c.name) AS name, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN c.name_en ELSE p.name_en END AS name_en FROM block b JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE b.uploader_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_active = true AND b.is_listed = true GROUP BY COALESCE(p.code, c.code), COALESCE(p.name, c.name), CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN c.name_en ELSE p.name_en END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(b.created_at) LIMIT 3

WITH mine AS (SELECT id FROM block WHERE uploader_id = #{userId} AND is_active = true) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = #{userId} AND b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_listed = true) AS listed_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.uploader_id = #{userId} AND b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ub.user_id) FROM user_block ub JOIN mine m ON m.id = ub.block_id WHERE ub.user_id <> #{userId}) AS collectors, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.playlist_id) FROM playlist_block pb JOIN mine m ON m.id = pb.block_id JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.id = pb.layer_id JOIN playlist p ON p.id = l.playlist_id WHERE p.user_id <> #{userId}) AS used_in_combos

WITH days AS ( SELECT generate_series((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 13, (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS d ), since AS ( SELECT (((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 13)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS t ), mine AS (SELECT id FROM block WHERE uploader_id = #{userId}), my_combos AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.playlist_id AS id FROM playlist_block pb JOIN mine m ON m.id = pb.block_id JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.id = pb.layer_id ), collects AS ( SELECT ((ub.acquired_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM user_block ub JOIN mine m ON m.id = ub.block_id WHERE ub.user_id <> #{userId} AND ub.acquired_at >= (SELECT t FROM since) GROUP BY 1 ), plays AS ( SELECT ((pl.played_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM play_log pl WHERE pl.user_id <> #{userId} AND pl.played_at >= (SELECT t FROM since) AND ((pl.target_type = 'BLOCK' AND pl.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM mine)) OR (pl.target_type = 'PLAYLIST' AND pl.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM my_combos))) GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT days.d AS date, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS collects, COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS plays FROM days LEFT JOIN collects c ON c.d = days.d LEFT JOIN plays p ON p.d = days.d ORDER BY days.d
